meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能处理基因组区间数据:读取 BED 文件、查找区间重叠、生成覆盖度轨道、把基因组区域转成机器学习用的 token,还能管理参考序列和片段文件。
howto.when: 当你提到基因组区间、BED 文件或覆盖度轨道,或要求做重叠检测、token 化等分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这两个BED文件里有哪些区间重叠。
say.note: Claude 会用 gtars 的 IGD 索引查询重叠。

say.text: 把这个BED文件生成BigWig覆盖度轨道。
say.note: Claude 会运行 uniwig 生成覆盖度文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process genomic interval data: read BED files, find overlaps, generate coverage tracks, tokenize regions for ML, manage reference sequences, and handle fragment files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention genomic regions, BED files, coverage tracks, overlap detection, tokenization for ML, or fragment analysis.

say_en.text: Find overlapping intervals between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will use gtars IGD indexing to query overlaps.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from this BED file.
say_en.note: Claude will run uniwig to create the coverage file.

say_en.text: Create a tokenizer from these training regions and tokenize chr1:1000-2000.
say_en.note: Claude will build a TreeTokenizer and perform tokenization.
